6	
7	Created `package.json` (type: module, engines node>=24, only `typescript`/`@types/node` as dev deps), `tsconfig.json`, extended the existing `.gitignore` with `*.db`/`*.db-journal`/`*.db-wal`, `test/smoke.test.ts`, and `README.md`.
8	
9	Decision for later tasks: on this Node version, `node --test test/` (directory with a trailing slash as a CLI arg) fails with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` — it gets misparsed as a module path rather than a test-discovery root. `node --test` with no path argument works correctly and auto-discovers everything under `test/`, and `node --test test/<file>.test.ts` (a specific file, no trailing slash) also works fine. The `test` script in `package.json` is `"node --test"` (no path). Later tasks' per-task verify commands that target one file (e.g. `node --test test/store.test.ts`) are unaffected; just don't pass a bare directory with a trailing slash to `node --test`.
